prompt: Insertion in DLL: Why is the order of pointer updates important in a doubly linked insertion?

options.text: It proves every implementation is correct without any tests.

options.text: Overwriting a link too early can lose access to one of the neighbours.
options.explain: A safe sequence keeps every node reachable until all four links are consistent.
